info.title: Ardea API
info.description: Self-hosted early warning for security vulnerabilities. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`.

value.description: The effective value; always null for secrets.

isSet.description: Whether a value is in effect, from the environment, the database or a default.

locked.description: Set by an environment variable: shown read-only.

UpdateInstanceSettingsRequest.description: Absent fields stay unchanged; an empty string removes a stored value.
